missingJobTimeout.reason: the step fetches every pinned action ref from github.com, so a hung fetch runs to the six hour default
it is the aggregate gate every other lane reports into; a hang here holds the CI concurrency group and blocks the production deploy that waits on this workflow
a CodeQL database build on a large Rust tree has no natural ceiling
a tag validation step should never outlive a few minutes
a cross platform cargo release build; the matrix runs five of them at once
